question.instructions: Which part of Ruff (a Python linter and formatter) does this issue concern?

criteria.linter: Lint rules, their fixes, suppression comments (noqa), import sorting, docstring checks, diagnostics or preview rules.
criteria.formatter: The code formatter: how formatted code looks.
criteria.server: The language server (LSP) and editor integration.
criteria.configuration: Settings, the command-line interface, or selecting which rules are enabled.
